summary_en: Sodick authorized the acquisition of up to 2.4 million shares (4.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from the business day after settlement of a concurrent equity offering through December 23, 2026, to mitigate supply-demand impacts and strengthen shareholder returns under the mid-term plan Grow Forward 2029.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 5, 2026, Sodick's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's Articles of Incorporation Article 42. The company will acquire up to 2.4 million shares of common stock, representing 4.8% of outstanding shares (49,976,750 shares excluding treasury stock as of the announcement date), for a maximum total consideration of 3.0 billion yen.

The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period commences on the business day following settlement of a concurrent public offering of shares announced the same day (expected October 22–27, 2026, depending on the pricing date) and runs through December 23, 2026. The specific start date is contingent on the equity offering's settlement schedule, with four possible commencement dates ranging from October 22 to October 27.

The company stated two rationales for this acquisition: to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency as outlined in its mid-term management plan Grow Forward 2029, and to mitigate the supply-demand impact on Sodick's share price arising from the concurrent equity offering. The company notes that full or partial acquisition may not occur depending on market conditions. Implementation authority was delegated to the representative director and CEO.
